classes.name: AbstractUploadManager
classes.description: An abstract class that defines the structure and workflow for managing multipart uploads to AWS, including initiation, uploading parts, and completion handling.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the upload manager with an AWS client and optional configuration.

methods.name: upload
methods.description: Executes the upload process synchronously and returns the result.

methods.name: promise
methods.description: Begins or returns the ongoing asynchronous upload process as a promise.

methods.name: transformException
methods.description: Transforms exceptions into specific multipart upload exceptions.

methods.name: buildFailureCatch
methods.description: Builds a catch handler to process errors during async operations.

methods.name: loadUploadWorkflowInfo
methods.description: Abstract method to load service-specific upload workflow info.

methods.name: determinePartSize
methods.description: Abstract method to determine the size of upload parts.

methods.name: handleResult
methods.description: Abstract method to process the result of each uploaded part.

methods.name: getInitiateParams
methods.description: Abstract method to get parameters for initiating the upload.

methods.name: getCompleteParams
methods.description: Abstract method to get parameters for completing the upload.

methods.name: determineState
methods.description: Creates or retrieves the upload state object based on provided IDs or configuration.

methods.name: getResultHandler
methods.description: Provides response handling middleware for upload commands.

methods.name: getUploadCommands
methods.description: Abstract method to generate the sequence of upload part commands.
